name: grep-finder
description: Grep-style multi-file finder: control context lines like -A/-B/-C and open several matches side-by-side, each at its own match. Fully offline, no network access, uses the ripgrep already bundled with VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Searching is read-only and runs in untrusted workspaces. For safety, a workspace-defined 'grepFinder.ripgrepPath' is ignored in untrusted workspaces; the editor's bundled ripgrep is used instead.

grepFinder.defaultContextLines.description: Default number of context lines (both before and after) shown around each match.

enumDescriptions: Retile the editor area and give every selected match its own group, side by side.
Open the selected matches as ordinary tabs in the active editor group, leaving the layout alone.
grepFinder.openMode.description: How the Open button opens the selected matches. This only sets the starting mode; the grid/tabs toggle in the panel remembers your last choice.

grepFinder.maxGridEditors.description: Maximum number of editors opened at once when using 'Open in grid'.

grepFinder.maxTabEditors.description: Maximum number of tabs opened at once when using 'Open in tabs'. Counted per file, since a file can only have one tab.

grepFinder.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to collect per search before truncating.

grepFinder.ripgrepPath.description: Optional absolute path to a ripgrep (rg) binary. Leave empty to use the ripgrep that VS Code ships with (falling back to 'rg' on your PATH).

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile:integration && node out/test/integration/runTest.js
